description: This PHP source file defines the 'DocProps' class responsible for writing document property XML files for XLSX spreadsheets in the PhpSpreadsheet library. The class includes methods to generate 'app.xml', 'core.xml', and 'custom.xml' with spreadsheet metadata like author, title, and other custom properties.

classes.name: DocProps
classes.description: Class responsible for generating XML representations of spreadsheet document properties for XLSX files, including application info, core metadata, and custom properties.

methods.name: writeDocPropsApp
methods.description: Generates the app.xml content with application properties, sheet count, titles, company, manager, and version.

methods.name: writeDocPropsCore
methods.description: Generates the core.xml content with author, last modified by, creation, modification dates, title, description, subject, keywords, and category.

methods.name: writeDocPropsCustom
methods.description: Generates custom.xml content with user-defined custom properties if any are set in the spreadsheet.
